backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a homepage hero message update affecting App.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files including styling, Tailwind config, main app, asset helper, and footer component.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH design tokens for light/dark themes and global body styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React UI defining header, hero section, navigation, service listings, and footer with smooth-scroll behavior.
frontend/src/components/LiveUrlFooter.ts: React component showing current site URL with a copy-to-clipboard button and success state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and caching an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity auth provider and hook managing login, stored identities, and status handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining a warm neutral palette, typography rules, and scroll behavior.
frontend/src/lib/assetPaths.ts: Utility that builds base-path-safe URLs for static assets using Vite's BASE_URL.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending color tokens, shadows, radius, animations, and fonts with required plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, existing and new feature requests, and the goal of adding a welcome message below the shop title on the homepage.
